headline: Lyleen top planter
title: Lyleen | Planting Seven and Party Healer | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want the best planter in Palworld one point zero? Lyleen is a Grass Pal with Planting level seven, Gathering level six, plus Handiwork and Medicine Production at level five. Its partner skill, Harvest Goddess, restores the health of you and your party Pals by eighty to ninety percent. A farm worker and a healer in one. Will you raise Lyleen? Comment below!
description: Lyleen in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass Pal with Planting level seven and a party healing partner skill.
